Finally!

notes.title: If the game works slowly
If the game works slowly
BUG FIX - NEUROSIS DIFFICULTY
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25162411/6702aaf0ef3eb7db3a7acbe7962c23160bb44470.png[/img]

Fixed the problem with neurosis difficulty - in some cases this difficulty didn't open after beating the game. Now everything is fine. If you already beat the game before that update - you should beat the last stage again and watch the titles. After that neurosis difficulty will be able on all of save slots.

Report me about any bugs and I'll fix them all!

notes.title: Reflection of Mine - Full Release!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25162411/89b30c9a4ecb783f29fc04e56ac5b3447e795500.png[/img]

Reflection of Mine is leaving EA!

Whats new:

- MacOS support
- Fourth chapter is available 
- 12 new main stages
- Some secret stages 
- 3 endings
- More achievements
- Neurosis difficulty now available after completing whole game on normal difficulty
- Added education before the third boss
- Fixed some issues with the third boss
- Music quality increased

Feel free to report me about about any bugs - I'll fix it as soon as I can!

notes.title: Version 0.7.0 Update
notes.content:

Hey! Here goes a big update - chapter three is opened!
This means:

- Minimum three more hours of gameplay
- 12 new levels
- 4 bonus puzzles
- 2 bonus levels
- New story from Lilly's memories about choosing the religion

Bugs fixed:

- Problems with achievements on some OS
- Behavior of helpers in chapter two
- Glitches with the main menu

Have a good time in Reflection of Mine and don't forget to report bugs!

notes.title: Version 0.6 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25162411/d47dbf901dab29e27276cb39cc1bcc228e5c3c1d.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 
Here goes the second update and here are some changes it brings:

- Mouse is available now - player can use it in the menu, options, chapter and level select screens
- Fixed some issues with English localization
- Fixed some bugs with the Ugly One
- Some UI elements may react on the mouse clicking - I'm working on integration of full mouse controll. Soon player will be abble to choose control metod - keyboard, mouse or gamepad
- Fixed bug with black screen after second walkthrough of the stage
- Fixed bug with eternal death cycle during collecting the keys

I hope you all keep enjoying [b]Reflection of Mine![/b]

notes.title: Version 0.5 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25162411/e6bb57a80d8d6805d997e4ce2ad2c750105ea270.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 
Here goes the first update and, first of all, I rebuilt a "help" system a litle bit. So, check out the new features: 

- You can use "step back" in the first chapter more often 
- Speed of the "Pretenders" was changed - now these guys, who show us the way, move three times slower 
- Difficulty of "Arcade Mode" was changed too - now it's easier to get help points 
- I've added some new elements to the UI - now player can see how many help points he got and what he should press to use them 
- From this moment if player suffered enough and Pretender told that rush through memories is avaliable now, player don't need to leave the stage - it's possible to go to rish through memories from any point of the map with saving the progress (keys, doors, amount of steps, etc) 
- Fixed some issues with English localization 

I hope you all keep enjoying [b]Reflection of Mine![/b]
